Space Battle.name: Space Battle
Space Battle.summary:
Space Battle is a one-player game that pits you against the computer.

Six alien fleets of different sizes are attacking your mothership, and it's up to you to defend it using your three squadrons. Alien ships will dodge your attacks and will attack you with photon blasts.

TRON Deadly Discs.name: Tron: Deadly Discs
TRON Deadly Discs.summary: The ultimate in futuristic adventure! Based on the Motion Picture from Walt Disney Productions. Move TRON safely through battle against warriors attacking in waves of three against one. Lethal saucers are the weapons. Score points by knocking them out before they get TRON!
